boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public destinations on practical downtown and near-east-side corridors from Mount Carmel College of Nursing.

cards.title: COSI on West Broad
cards.subtitle: West Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the visit calendar to choose an exhibit or program, then plan your route to the science center at 333 West Broad Street.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on science destination on the Broad Street riverfront.
cards.evidence_claim: COSI identifies itself as Columbus’s Center of Science and Industry and lists its address as 333 West Broad Street.
cards.access_notes: Check COSI’s visit calendar and ticket options before going.

cards.title: National Veterans Memorial and Museum on West Broad
cards.subtitle: West Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Set aside time for the narrative galleries, which use veterans’ artifacts, letters, imagery, and filmed testimony to tell service stories.
cards.short_summary: A museum centered on individual veterans’ experiences across eras and branches.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum at 300 West Broad Street presents veterans’ stories through artifacts, quotes, letters, imagery, and films.
cards.access_notes: Daily admission is ticketed; check current admission details before visiting.

cards.title: Genoa Park on West Broad
cards.subtitle: West Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Take the paved path from the Broad Street side and connect to the Scioto Trail for a riverfront walk or bike ride.
cards.short_summary: A city park with waterfront paths and direct Scioto Mile access.
cards.evidence_claim: Genoa Park, at 303 W Broad Street, has greenway-trail access, a paved path, waterfront, and the Scioto Trail running through it.
cards.access_notes: The city lists park hours as 7 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Bicentennial Park on Civic Center Drive
cards.subtitle: Civic Center Drive corridor
cards.notes: Walk the riverfront paths and check the schedule for performances at the park’s stage; fountain activity can be seasonal.
cards.short_summary: A Scioto Mile park with a fountain, stage, and riverfront setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Bicentennial Park at 233 Civic Center Drive includes the Scioto Mile Fountain and a performance stage that hosts free music, dance, and theatrical performances.
cards.access_notes: The Scioto Mile lists park hours as 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; confirm event and fountain conditions before departure.

cards.title: Scioto Audubon on West Whittier
cards.subtitle: West Whittier Street corridor
cards.notes: Start at the West Whittier entrance and use the Scioto Greenway or Connector trail for a self-paced outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: A 119-acre riverfront park with connected trails and nature-focused recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Scioto Audubon at 400 W Whittier Street has a 2-mile Scioto Greenway trail and a 2.5-mile Connector trail.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 6:30 a.m.–10 p.m. April–September and 6:30 a.m.–8 p.m. October–March.

cards.title: Ohio Statehouse at Capitol Square
cards.subtitle: Broad and High Streets corridor
cards.notes: Enter via Third Street and join a walk-in guided tour, or use the self-guided materials to explore public spaces at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A working state capitol with daily public tours and self-guided options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio Statehouse at 1 Capitol Square offers free guided tours daily except state holidays and permits self-guided visits.
cards.access_notes: Walk-in tour times and public access can vary with state activity; check the visitor page before going.

cards.title: Columbus Commons on South High
cards.subtitle: South High Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the open lawn and event calendar for a low-key downtown stop; the park spans from High Street to Third Street.
cards.short_summary: A downtown green space with recurring public events and a carousel.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbus Commons, 160 S High Street, hosts concerts, fitness classes, movie nights, markets, and other events.
cards.access_notes: The park lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; it can close temporarily for private events.

cards.title: Main Library on South Grant
cards.subtitle: South Grant Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to the third-floor Business & Nonprofit Resource Center when you need computers, Adobe Creative Cloud, or research help from librarians.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library branch with specialized research space and computing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Library’s Business & Nonprofit Resource Center at 96 S Grant Avenue provides computers with Adobe Creative Cloud and librarian assistance.
cards.access_notes: Confirm branch hours and any room-access requirements on the library website before arrival.

cards.title: Columbus Museum of Art on East Broad
cards.subtitle: East Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Build a visit around the hands-on Center for Creativity, then check the museum calendar for its current galleries and programs.
cards.short_summary: An art museum with hands-on creative spaces alongside galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Columbus Museum of Art at 480 E Broad Street has a Center for Creativity with hands-on activities, studio experiences, and experimental galleries.
cards.access_notes: Visitors age 25 and under receive free daily admission at the East Broad Street campus; check the current visit page for hours.

cards.entity_name: Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens
cards.title: Franklin Park Conservatory on East Broad
cards.subtitle: East Broad Street corridor
cards.notes: Choose a season or exhibition before you go, then allow time to move through the botanical gardens and indoor plant collections.
cards.short_summary: A botanical-garden destination with changing exhibitions and plant displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens is located at 1777 E Broad Street in Columbus.
cards.source_title: Visit Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens
cards.access_notes: Review current hours, ticketing, and exhibition information before visiting.
